description: CsNa₅(WN₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Cs-N bond distances ranging from 3.13-3.33 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Cs-N bond distances ranging from 3.06-3.41 Å. There are ten inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.43-3.02 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.69 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.78 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.91 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.74 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WN₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.55 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.88 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.82 Å. In the ninth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.94 Å. In the tenth Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WN₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.51 Å. There are four inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.93 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two WN₄ tetrahedra and corners with four NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.94 Å. In the third W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.96 Å. In the fourth W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form corner-sharing WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.94 Å. There are twelve inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Cs, four Na, and one W atom. In the second N site, N is bonded to four Na and two W atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NNa₄W₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. In the third N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Cs, three Na, and one W atom. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Cs, four Na, and one W atom. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one W atom. In the sixth N site, N is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Cs, five Na, and one W atom. In the seventh N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Cs, three Na, and two W atoms. In the eighth N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Cs, three Na, and two W atoms. In the ninth N site, N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cs, three Na, and one W atom. In the tenth N site, N is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Cs, five Na, and one W atom. In the eleventh N site, N is bonded to four Na and two W atoms to form corner-sharing NNa₄W₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. In the twelfth N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one W atom.
